description: Held weapon charge (context/designs/modding/held-weapon-events.md, slice 5). On Felicity with no simulants, player 0 is given the Mauler, fires its primary once, switches to its secondary and waits while the charge builds (it builds while the function is selected: five steps in 100 ticks, one round a step, never below a clip of 2), then fires the charged shot. Each function's first press logs its program's plan beside the original's: the primary is a single hitscan shot, the secondary og.weapon.charge with the original's numbers (damage 10/3 a step). They must be equal, and no rule may differ in the totals at the scripted exit.

input_sequence.comment: Wait for first-person Combat Simulator gameplay.
From the give to its first input there are 3 s (equip time).

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_MODE
input_sequence.comment: Switch to the charge-up shot; the charge builds while it is selected.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Fire the charged shot, well after its 100 ticks (1.7 s) to full.
